propositions: The updater installs via pipx VCS resolution, which bypasses the committed uv lock and Click security override, resolving incompatible eval+dev dependencies
The updater must perform exact-SHA git checkout followed by uv sync --locked with runtime/operator extras (mcp, reviewbot, ui, agents, eval, tracing, grounding, grounding-t2) and --no-dev flag
The updater must preserve repository pyproject.toml and uv.lock unchanged and verify Click 8.4.2 in the published runtime without PYSEC-2026-2132 vulnerability
Sync or smoke-test failures must reject the candidate, log the failure reason, and leave the current installation byte-identical

The updater must use atomic filesystem operations (single-flight lock and atomic rename) to transition from current release to new versioned release, with crash probes verifying all-old or all-new observable state
After successful publication, only the published release remains; launchd-triggered updates detect no-op when already on target SHA
